_what: The only numbers in the PMN dashboard that cannot be pulled headlessly. Read off the 'R&D Efficiency' Power BI app by an interactive session and committed here. `edct_series` feeds the EDCT chart; everything else is the reconciliation baseline the verification gate checks the live Jira numbers against.
_how_to_refresh: In an interactive Claude session: run the pmn-kpi-dashboard skill (it reads Power BI via the browser), then copy its report_values.json over the keys below and commit. Filters to verify on every page: RESOLUTION/RESOLVED DATE = 2026, PROJECT = Performance Management Native, TEAM = All; EDCT page also IMPLEMENTED BY AI AGENT = Yes.
_staleness: EDCT is a monthly average, so a snapshot 1-3 weeks old is still fair -- the chart caption always states this as-of date. Refresh it at least once a month, and whenever a month closes.
